meta.title: Erik András Birkl – Software Engineer
meta.description: Erik András Birkl, software engineer in Budapest. Web interfaces with React and TypeScript.

hero.name: Erik András Birkl
hero.lead: I build web interfaces with React and TypeScript. I've been working at Vidux since 2024.
hero.availability: Open to remote and hybrid roles, and on-site opportunities as well. Relocation is not an issue.

about.title: About
paragraphs: I went to a high school with a media specialization in Kispest, Budapest, where I first got into visual communication. After that I studied Computer Science Engineering in Szeged and graduated in 2026.
I've been a software engineer at Vidux since 2024. What interests me most is the space between design and code: how a Figma file turns into a working interface.
Outside work I ride motorcycles and like tinkering, for example on my car. I'm also into 3D printing and languages.

skills.title: Toolkit
skills.intro: React and TypeScript are what I use every day. The rest depends on the project.

kerian.name: KERIAN webshop
kerian.subtitle: Clothing webshop with Stripe payments and AI recommendations
kerian.description: It started as my thesis and I've kept working on it since. I'm building everything myself, from the UI design through the database and the REST backend to payments. You can already filter by size, colour and gender, use a cart and a wishlist, and pay by card. Right now I'm working on the admin side.

highlights.title: AI recommendations
highlights.body: Claude Haiku 4.5 suggests items that match the cart in style and colour, never ones already in it.

highlights.title: Stripe payments
highlights.body: Online card payments from the cart to the order confirmation.

highlights.title: 2FA-protected admin
highlights.body: Admins sign in with a TOTP code and see revenue, orders and trends live.

highlights.title: Race-condition-safe stock
highlights.body: Pessimistic row-level locking keeps stock from going below zero when orders come in at the same time.

vidux.summary: I work on the frontend of security and video recording systems built for banks, using React and TypeScript.
vidux.intro: Vidux builds IP-based security and video recording systems for banks.
tasks: Build web frontends with React, TypeScript and JavaScript.
Turn Figma designs into interfaces, working closely with the designers.
Connect backend APIs so live video, device status, analytics dashboards and alarms show up in the UI.
Develop and maintain the company's private npm package of shared UI components, used across several internal projects.
Took on backend tasks when the team needed it, such as writing database migration scripts.

caballo.summary: I entered and managed accounting data. I'm comfortable with monotonous, detail-heavy work.

sziget.summary: I worked as a barback at one of Europe's biggest festivals. Long shifts, few breaks and constant rushing, so heavy workloads are nothing new to me.
tasks: Supported the bartenders: restocking, prep and glassware.
Worked long shifts with few breaks.
Kept up a constant pace in big crowds.

university.summary: Software design, algorithms, databases and systems, with plenty of hands-on projects. My thesis is the KERIAN webshop.
